# Support

- **Documentation:** the [README](../README.md) covers the API, the CLI and every token.
- **Try it:** the [playground](https://id-generator.pages.dev/) runs the library in your browser.
- **Bugs:** open an [issue](https://github.com/VectoDE/ID-Generator/issues/new/choose) with the bug template.
- **Questions and ideas:** use [Discussions](https://github.com/VectoDE/ID-Generator/discussions).
- **Security problems:** follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md). Never post them publicly.

This is a free library maintained in spare time. There is no guaranteed response time and no commercial support.
